descriptions.employee-type: Permanent, probation, contract and casual, each with its own entitlements.
descriptions.designation-group: The categories designations are grouped under, and the manpower category (Operator, Quality, Helper, Supervisor, Staff) each counts as.
descriptions.grade: Pay grades used by employees and salary structures.
descriptions.pay-element: Earnings and deductions: basic, house rent, medical, food, transport and the rest.
descriptions.allowance-entry: Allowances payable to employees for a pay period, entered or uploaded.
descriptions.head-wise-deduction: Deductions against employees for a pay period, by deduction head.
descriptions.shift-master: Shift times, break, working hours, grace time, cross-day and OT settings, effective-dated.
descriptions.leave-type: Leave types, paid or unpaid, with eligibility and balance rules.
descriptions.ot-rule: How an OT hour is priced — wage basis, hourly formula, multiplier — by effective date, category and grade.
descriptions.bonus-rules-setup: Festival bonus rules by service length, salary band, basis and percentage.
descriptions.salary-policy-and-rules: Wage gazettes and the salary structures under them, versioned by effective date.
descriptions.gazette-grade-wage: What each gazette fixes per grade — Basic, House Rent, allowances — and the Gross-A letters print.
descriptions.festival-calendar: Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha and other festivals by year, the month each bonus is paid in, and the holidays attendance reads.
descriptions.company-pay-period: Pay periods, the salary day basis, late deduction rule and rounding payroll is processed with.

et.hint: Type Level is derived from the parent on save.
et.level_hint: One below the parent type. A type with no parent sits at level 1.
et.tree_hint: Select a node to see the types filed under it. What you select becomes the Parent Type of anything you add.
et.select_node: Please select a node for operation
et.select_node_hint: Its types load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
et.no_children: Add the first one with New above.
et.footer: :count types. Type Level is the parent's level plus one and is not typed — the printed form greys it out for the same reason. A node stops being a leaf the moment it gets a child, and becomes one again when its last child goes.
et.tree_form_hint: Type Level is the parent's level plus one and is not typed — the printed form greys it out for the same reason. A node stops being a leaf the moment it gets a child, and becomes one again when its last child goes.

dg.hint: Group Level is derived from the parent on save.
dg.level_hint: One below the parent — picking Chairman puts this group directly under it.
dg.manpower_hint: What the HR and Company dashboards count this group's employees as. Empty = read from the designation title.

gr.hint: The same grades as Company Management → Designation & Grade: a grade is kept once and read by both.

pe.hint: Every element needs a GL mapping before payroll can post it — see Payroll Element Map.

al.hint: One entry per element per employee per period; re-entering the same trio replaces the amount. Choose Excel Upload to bring a file in instead — the Excel Upload tab stages it, checks every line and applies only the clean ones.
al.excel_hint: Excel Upload is the tab beside this one — a file is staged and checked before anything is paid.

de.hint: One deduction per head per employee per period — the same head cannot be deducted twice.
de.company_hint: The company the chosen pay period belongs to.

up.hint_allowance: Attach an allowance file, check every line against the employee register and the chosen period, then apply the clean rows.
up.hint_deduction: Attach a deduction file, check every line against the employee, head and period registers, then apply the clean rows.
up.columns_allowance: Columns: employee_code, amount. The Template button downloads a sample.
up.columns_deduction: Columns: employee_code, pay_element (the head code, e.g. MED), amount. The Template button downloads a sample.
up.element_hint: The element every line in this file is for.
up.company_hint: The company every line in this file belongs to.
up.period_hint: Used for any line whose Pay Period Id column is blank.
up.carries: Attach a delimited file whose header row carries: :headers.
up.rule_allowance: A line is applied only if its employee code resolves to somebody active in the company above, and that element is not already entered for them in that period. Nothing is written until Upload — Show File Data checks and shows, it does not save.
up.rule_deduction: A line is applied only if its employee code and deduction head both resolve, its pay period is open and belongs to the company above, and that head is not already deducted from that employee for that period. Nothing is written until Upload — Show File Data checks and shows, it does not save.

sh.hint: The attendance engine reads the shift for every punch: late minutes from start + grace, early out and OT from the regular end. A night shift's OUT punch is taken on the next day.
sh.start_hint: Arriving after start + grace is late, counted from the start (08:00 + 15: 08:10 is on time, 08:16 is 16 minutes late).
sh.break_hint: Clock time the break begins, e.g. 13:00. Blank = the middle of the shift.
sh.hours_hint: Regular hours; the rest of the shift is overtime. Leave blank to take the span less the break.
sh.grace_hint: Blank uses Payroll Settings → Default Grace Minutes.
sh.cross_hint: Set automatically when the end is before the start (22:00 – 06:00).

lt.hint: Leave Group decides whether a day under this type counts as leave, present or absent — attendance and payroll both branch on it.

ot.hint: Hourly rate = wage basis ÷ divisor × multiplier. When several rules apply to an employee on a day, the one naming their grade wins, then the one naming their category, then the general rule.
ot.divisor_hint: Monthly wage ÷ this = one ordinary hour (208 = 26 days × 8 hours).
ot.to_hint: Leave blank while the rule is current.

bo.hint: Department, designation group and team narrow a rule — leave them empty to apply it to everyone of that employee type. When several rules match, the one naming the most wins.
bo.set_hint: The set a festival names on the Festival Calendar. Only rules in that set price its bonus.
bo.months_hint: In months, completed on the festival date.
bo.amount_hint: A percentage of the basis, or a fixed amount below — one of the two.

wg.title: Wage Gazette
wg.hint: Declare a wage board gazette — number, year, industry, effective date and reference — the policies published under it, and read its salary structure per category.
wg.existing_hint: Choose one to load it back into the form, or leave blank to create.
wg.effective_hint: The date the board's rates take effect. Compliance checks read the newest gazette in force on a date.
wg.active_hint: Status. A superseded gazette stays active for the employees still on it; untick only one nobody uses.
wg.reference_placeholder: https://… link to the published gazette, or a file path
wg.policies_hint: The named rules this gazette publishes. A code is unique within the gazette, so the same code may recur under a later one.
wg.structure_hint: What this gazette sets per employee category, read from the structure lines on the Records tab: Basic is the multiplier the gross is divided by, House Rent a percentage of Basic, the rest amounts in taka.
wg.no_structure: No structure lines under this gazette yet.
wg.versioning: A new wage board is a new gazette with its own effective date — the old one stays as it was, so payslips made under it still read true and employees move to the new one as their structures are re-set.
wg.delete_confirm: Delete this gazette and its policies?
wg.line_hint: A new wage board is a new gazette (Wage Gazette tab) with its own lines here. Lines of an older gazette stay for the employees and payslips made under it.
wg.amount_hint: Basic Pay: the divisor (Basic = (Gross − fixed allowances) ÷ it). House Rent: % of Basic. Gross Pay: the Gross Minimum salaries are checked against. Any other element: taka.

gg.hint: Gross-A = Basic + House Rent + Medical + Conveyance + Food + Other. Letters read the line for the employee's gazette, category and grade.

fe.hint: The date is set for each year — never assumed. The bonus rule set decides who is eligible and how much.
fe.date_hint: Each year’s Eid-ul-Fitr, Eid-ul-Adha and other festivals are entered on their own.
fe.month_hint: The payroll month the bonus is paid with.
fe.rule_hint: The rule set on Bonus Rule that prices this festival's bonus.
fe.service_hint: Completed on the festival date. 0 for none.
fe.eligibility_placeholder: e.g. Confirmed employees with the minimum service on the festival date
fe.reference_placeholder: Moon-sighting notice, government circular or board decision
fe.holiday_hint: Files the days in the holiday register and puts them on the attendance calendar.
fe.holiday_form_hint: Written to the holiday register attendance reads; a dated holiday is put on the calendar straight away.
fe.delete_holiday: A holiday that has put days on the calendar is kept — deactivate it instead. Days already on the calendar are never overwritten.
fe.recurring_hint: Only for holidays fixed in the Gregorian calendar.
fe.footer: :count festival(s). One with a bonus run against it is kept; mark it Inactive instead.
fe.delete_festival: One with a bonus run against it is kept; mark it Inactive instead.

pp.hint: The pay period number is generated on save from the company, year and month — it is not typed.
pp.no_hint: Generated on save from the company, year and month.
pp.search_hint: Leave a box empty to ignore it. An empty panel loads every period, newest pay date first. Part of a number is enough — it matches anywhere in it.

ps.settings_hint: The salary day basis, late deduction rule and rounding every salary screen is computed with. Type over a value and Save.
ps.settings_footer: :count settings. Changes apply to the next Calculate on Daily and Monthly Salary — figures already approved or finalized are not recomputed. Only Salary Finalize holders (HR Admin, Factory Manager) can change these.

SALARY_DAY_BASIS.label: Salary Day Basis
SALARY_DAY_BASIS.what: A month's salary ÷ this = one day's wage (daily salary, absence, late).

LATE_DEDUCTION_MODE.label: Late Deduction Mode
LATE_DEDUCTION_MODE.what: LATE_DAYS: every N late days cost one day's wage, decided monthly. PER_MINUTE: each late minute costs a day's wage ÷ 480.

LATE_DAYS_PER_DEDUCTION.label: Late Days per Deduction
LATE_DAYS_PER_DEDUCTION.what: N in “every N late days = one day's wage” (LATE_DAYS mode).

LATE_DEDUCTION_BASIS.label: Late Deduction Basis
LATE_DEDUCTION_BASIS.what: The wage a late day or late minute is priced from.

DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES.label: Default Grace Minutes
DEFAULT_GRACE_MINUTES.what: Grace for a shift that does not carry its own (HR-17).

ROUND_NET_TO.label: Round Net To (taka)
ROUND_NET_TO.what: Net pay is rounded down to this note size; 1 = no rounding.

ps.actions_hint: Move a pay period through its life — submit it for activation, activate it, close it.
ps.select_company_hint: Its pay periods load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
ps.no_periods: Add one on the New pay period tab.
ps.actions_footer: :count pay periods. The totals are what salary processing wrote — they are read here, never typed. Only the transitions its current status allows will succeed; the rest are refused with the reason.
ps.fy_hint: The fiscal and calendar year a pay period is filed under. Create one here without leaving the screen.
ps.select_register_hint: Its fiscal years load beside it, and nothing is read from the database until you do.
ps.no_years: Add the first one with Add year, then Save.
ps.fy_footer: :count fiscal years. The fiscal year is the accounting year a period is reported in; the calendar year is the one it falls in. They differ in Bangladesh — a July-to-June fiscal year spans two calendar years — which is why both are asked for.

master.parent_cycle: A row cannot sit under itself or anything filed under it.
master.type_taken: There is already an employee type with this name.
master.group_taken: There is already a designation group with this name.
master.grade_taken: There is already a grade with this number.
master.element_taken: There is already a pay element with this code.
master.shift_taken: There is already a shift with this code.
master.time_format: Enter the time as HH:MM, e.g. 08:00.
master.leave_taken: There is already a leave type with this code.
master.ot_taken: There is already an OT rule with this code.
master.effective_order: Effective To cannot be before Effective From.
master.band_order: The high limit cannot be below the low one (0 means no upper limit).
master.bonus_amount_required: Give a bonus percentage or a fixed bonus.
master.amount_positive: The amount must be more than zero.
master.line_taken: This gazette already sets this pay element for this category.
master.grade_wage_taken: This gazette already fixes a wage for this category and grade.
master.holiday_taken: There is already a holiday with this code.
master.holiday_outside_year: The start date must fall inside the fiscal year.
master.holiday_on_calendar: This holiday has put days on the calendar — deactivate it instead.
master.festival_year: The year must be the festival date’s year.
master.festival_taken: This festival is already on the calendar for that year.
master.festival_no_year: No fiscal year holds that date, so its holiday cannot be filed — add the year first.
master.period_order: End Date cannot be before Start Date.
master.period_closed: This pay period is closed; nothing more is entered against it.
master.period_step: :period moves one step at a time — it cannot go from :from to :to.
master.deduction_taken: :employee already has this head deducted in this period.
master.row_bad_amount: The amount must be a number above zero.
master.row_bad_head: No pay element has this code.
master.file_format: The file is not :format — pick the file type that matches it.
master.file_unreadable: The file could not be read as a list of rows.
master.gazette_taken: There is already a gazette with this name.
master.gazette_in_use: Structure lines or grade wages are filed under this gazette — remove them first, or untick Active.
master.rewriting: Rewriting :name. Save to keep the changes, or cancel to leave it as it was.
master.not_under_node: That type is not filed under this node.
master.row_bad_period: No open pay period has this number.
master.row_deducted: This head is already deducted from this employee for this period.
master.row_entered: This element is already entered for this employee in this period.
master.period_move: ":move" cannot be done on :period — it is :status.
master.fy_in_use: :year has pay periods or holidays filed under it and is kept.
master.holiday_no_date: A holiday without a start date cannot go on the calendar.
master.holiday_inactive: An inactive holiday does not go on the calendar.

descriptions.employee-quick-registration: Register an employee with basic and salary information; assignment can follow now or later.
descriptions.employee-register: Every employee, searchable, with assignment status and actions.
descriptions.employee-assignment: Assign factory, building, floor, department, section, line, designation, grade and shift; manpower updates as you save.
descriptions.employee-profile: An employee's full record: personal, job, salary and history.
descriptions.biometric-fingerprint: Device setup, fingerprint registration, employee mapping and each employee's biometric status.
descriptions.daily-attendance: The day's attendance from the punches: IN, OUT, working hours, late, early out and OT.
descriptions.biometric-sync: Pull punches from the attendance terminals and see each device's last sync.
descriptions.missing-punch: Days with an IN or OUT punch missing, and their correction for approval.
descriptions.attendance-correction: One employee's whole month on one chart: correct status, IN, OUT, late and OT, enter past days, delete a day.
descriptions.monthly-attendance-summary: The month-end job card summary by department or section: daily attendance and OT, present, leave and total OT per worker.
descriptions.shift-roster: Put an employee, several employees or a whole line on a shift, or on a weekly rotation, with weekly off.
descriptions.ot-correction: OT is paid automatically from attendance; correct a day's OT hours or rate here, with a reason and full history.
descriptions.ot-eligibility: Who earns OT: general OT for graded workers, Worker OT switched on for staff, and the OT limits per day.
descriptions.ot-request: Request OT for a section and line — select all of the line or pick employees — with the OT window and reason.
descriptions.ot-approval: Approve, reject or return OT requests, directly or from your approval inbox.
descriptions.daily-salary: Attendance-based pay for a day: daily rate, allowance and OT, less late and other deduction.
descriptions.ot-salary: Automatic OT from attendance after the shift end, its rate and amount, with corrections applied.
descriptions.festival-bonus: The festival bonus for the month's festival, by eligibility and bonus rule.
descriptions.monthly-salary: Load, calculate, review, approve and finalize the month's payroll, then payslips and bank/cash payment.
descriptions.payroll-adjustment: Correct a finalized month without rewriting it: raise the difference, approve it, and pay it with the next salary.
descriptions.employee-transfer: Move an employee to another department, section or line; manpower follows.
descriptions.employee-promotion: Old designation and grade to new, approved before it takes effect.
descriptions.employee-increment: A raise in Gross A, approved before it takes effect.
descriptions.employee-re-join: Re-activate a former employee's own record.
descriptions.employee-separation: Resignation, release or termination, approved before the employee leaves.
descriptions.final-settlement: A leaving employee's dues, deductions and final payable, approved and paid.
descriptions.lefty-management: Employees who left without notice: report, investigate, confirm or reject, reinstate — payroll eligibility follows the decision.
descriptions.letter-master: Letter types and their templates — subject, body, terms, signature — with employee fields and version control.
descriptions.generate-letter: Search by Employee Number, or pick a section, floor or all employees; preview, generate and print A4 letters.
descriptions.letter-history: Every letter issued, exactly as it was — view, print again or export.
descriptions.letter-reports: The letter register by type, department, section, floor, date and who generated it.
descriptions.hr-dashboard: Today's manpower, attendance, late, missing punch and OT across designations and lines, with pending approvals.
descriptions.hr-reports: Employee, manpower, attendance, OT, salary and HR reports — view, print, PDF and Excel.

f.code_hint: Generated on save; the next free number is shown.
f.name: Employee Name
f.joining_hint: Also the salary's effective date. Kept for the next entry.
f.gross_b_hint: Basis of the Complex (Gross B) payroll.
f.actual_hint: Kept on its own — never changes Gross A or Gross B.

emp.split_empty: Enter the gross to see the split.
emp.pending_hint: Employee is created without an assignment. Use Save & Assignment to assign now, or assign later from Employee Assignment.
emp.search_ph: Code, name, card, NID or mobile
emp.pick_hint: Pick one to assign or transfer, or tick several to assign them to the same placement.
emp.tick_page: Tick every employee on this page
emp.assign_empty: Pick an employee on the left, or tick several to assign them together.

p.floor_hint: Lists what is under the chosen building.
p.line_hint: Lists what is under the chosen floor.
p.reason_hint: The current posting is closed today and kept in the assignment history.

emp.rule_hint: Every option comes from Company Management — nothing can be created here. The posting takes effect today, the previous one is kept in the employee's assignment history, and manpower counts move the moment it is saved.
emp.nid_digits: NID No. must be 10, 13 or 17 digits.
emp.mobile_format: Mobile No. must be 11 digits starting with 01.
emp.dob_past: Date of Birth must be in the past.
emp.gross_too_low: The gross does not cover the fixed allowances of this structure.
emp.card_taken: Card / Proxi No. :card is already used by :code.

prof.new_note: Fill the tabs in any order — the whole profile is written in one save.
prof.edit_note: Rewriting :code. Save to keep the changes, or cancel to leave it as it was.
prof.search_note: Leave a box empty to ignore it. An empty panel loads the whole roster.
prof.code_hint: Part of a code is enough — it matches anywhere in it.
prof.gross_hint: Stored on the employee. The lines below are what it is made up of.
prof.card_hint: Card number the attendance terminal reads.
prof.photo_hint: Shown beside the header above, and on the printed profile. JPG or PNG, up to 2 MB.
prof.photo_failed: The photo could not be uploaded.
prof.photo_type: The photo must be a JPG or PNG.
prof.photo_size: The photo can be up to 2 MB.
prof.delete_confirm: The employee goes with their postings, salary history, pay lines and checks. One already used on another record cannot be removed.
prof.in_use: :code is already used on :n other record(s), so it cannot be removed — mark the employee Inactive instead.
prof.form_note: Fill the tabs in any order — the whole profile is written in one save, so a half-entered employee never reaches the database.

tab_note.job: Where the employee is posted, on what terms, and from when.
tab_note.contact: Addresses and the person to call. Saved with the employee, on the record hanging off it.
tab_note.document: Passport, driving licence and the photograph on the profile.

ad.title: Allowance / Deduction
ad.note: Set an employee's gross and the pay elements that make it up, in one entry.
ad.lines_note: One row per allowance or deduction. Core-salary lines are the ones the statutory calculations run on.
ad.empty: No pay elements yet. Add the allowances and deductions that make up this employee's salary.
ad.save_note: Saving replaces this employee's lines with what is on the grid, so removing a row here removes the line. The same element cannot be listed twice.

bg.title: Background checks
bg.note: Verification runs against one employee, with who cleared each and when.
bg.empty: No checks filed for this employee yet.
bg.footnote: Verified On is set when the check is filed; edit the other columns as the paperwork comes back.

v.card_required: Proxi# is required — the attendance terminal and the gate know the employee by it.
v.gross_required: Gross Salary is required for a new employee — the salary is split from it.
v.line_element: Every pay line needs its element.
v.separation_before: The separation date cannot be before the joining date.
v.passport_dates: The passport must expire after it was issued.
v.no_structure: No salary structure is set up for this employee type (Master Data → wage gazette).
v.line_twice: Row :n: the same element cannot be listed twice.

pr.no_lines: No allowance or deduction lines recorded.

idc.search_note: Search picks the employees; Add queues every one of them with the Print Option chosen here. Print Queue lays the queued cards out for the printer.
idc.code_hint: Part of a code is enough — it matches anywhere in it.
idc.single_hint: One card per sheet. Off prints the queue several to a page.
idc.empty: No card is waiting to be printed.
idc.form_note: The card renders from the employee profile — photo, section and designation are read at print time, so a queued card is never out of date. An employee with no photograph on file prints without one; the Photo column says which.
idc.removed: Card for :code removed from the queue.
idc.clear_confirm: Every card waiting to be printed is removed from the queue.
idc.remove_confirm: Only the queued card goes — the employee is not touched.
idc.queue_note: Single cards a sheet each; the rest several to a page, as the queue asked for.
idc.popup_blocked: The browser blocked the print window — allow pop-ups for this site.

bio.device_setup_note: The attendance terminals. Add, approve and configure them under Settings › Device Integration.
bio.no_devices: No attendance device is set up yet. Add one under Settings › Device Integration.
bio.enrol_note: Tick employees, then queue: they are mapped (PIN = card no.) and marked Pending. A push terminal receives the user on its next poll; once it reports their fingers they turn Registered.
bio.tick_page: Tick every employee on this page
bio.map_note: :name — the PIN the terminal knows them by. Defaults to the card number.
bio.delete_confirm: Their user and every finger are removed from every push terminal, and the fingerprints kept in the ERP are deleted. They will have to be enrolled again.
bio.mapping_note: Users the terminals hold that no employee is linked to. Their punches cannot be matched to anyone until they are mapped.
bio.all_mapped: Every device user is mapped to an employee.

done.enrol: :n employee(s) queued for :device — Pending until it reports their fingers.
done.send: :n employee(s) sent to :devices device(s) — :commands command(s) queued.
done.collect: :devices device(s) will send their users and fingers on their next call.

v.pin: PIN is required — letters and digits only.
v.push_active: Enrol on an active push terminal.
v.no_devices: No active push terminal to send to.

att.no_sections: No records to choose from yet.
att.terminals_note: Push terminals send punches on their own; Sync now works out today's attendance again from what has come in. A file taken off a terminal on a USB stick can be imported.
att.raw_note: :n punch(es) on this day · :u unmapped (card not held by any employee)
att.import_note: A terminal's attendance log taken off it on a USB stick (attlog.dat): user ID, time, verify and state, one punch a line. Punches already in are skipped; the days touched are worked out again.
att.missing_note: :n day(s) with a missing punch need a correction · :p correction(s) awaiting approval
att.choose_month: Choose an employee, a month and a year, then press Search.
att.delete_confirm: The day's correction goes, and the day is worked out again from the punches.
att.correction_note: A saved day is kept as corrected and is no longer worked out from the punches; delete it to go back to the punches. Late and OT are taken as entered; leave them empty to work them out from IN and OUT.
att.legend: P present · L late · A absent · MP missing punch · LV leave · H holiday · W weekly off; the small figure is the day's OT hours.
att.assign_note: An open-ended assignment starting today or earlier also becomes the employee's standing shift. Leave Weekly Off empty to keep each employee's usual off day.
att.weeks_hint: The pattern repeats over these weeks
att.roster_note: :n assignment(s) in force or upcoming. The newest assignment covering a day decides that day's shift.
att.remove_confirm: The days it covered are worked out again by whatever assignment is left.

empty.daily: No attendance for these days yet.
empty.devices: No attendance terminal is set up.
empty.missing: No missing punch in this range.
empty.summary: No employee in this department or section.
empty.roster: No assignment in force or upcoming.

done.synced: :n day(s) worked out again from the punches.
done.imported: :read punch(es) read, :saved new; :days day(s) worked out again.
done.requested: Correction for :code on :date requested — it waits for approval.
done.approved: Correction approved and written onto the day.
done.deleted: :code on :date is worked out from the punches again.

v.range: The To date cannot be before the From date.
v.line_empty: Nobody is posted to this line.
v.pattern: Pick a shift for every week of the pattern (at least two).
v.device: Pick the device the file came from.
v.file_format: No punch could be read — expected one per line: user ID, then YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.
v.one_time: Give the correct IN, the correct OUT, or both.
v.pending_exists: A correction for this day is already awaiting approval.
v.decided: This correction has already been decided.
v.future: A day still to come cannot be entered.

empty.records: Add the first one on the Save application tab.
empty.ot: No OT for this day and filter.

lo.delete_text: The application is removed and its days go back to the attendance as the punches show them.

ph.requests: Search by request no, line, section or date

hint.balance: Days left of the chosen type, from the entitlement register.
hint.apply_date: Stamped when the application is keyed.
hint.approve_date: Stamped when the decision is recorded.
hint.shift: The line's shift, filled in when a line is picked.
hint.send_to: Only users with OT Approval permission are listed.
hint.decision_note: Required to reject or return; optional to approve.

lo.form_note: Keyed by HR, so it may be saved already approved. Approving consumes the balance immediately.

status.balance_sub: What the applicant has left of each leave type. Entitled plus adjusted, less taken.
status.pick_text: Their leave types load beside it.
status.note: Taken is summed from the applications that were approved.

tile.general_caption: Graded workers with an OT rule

lo.reset_title: Back to the attendance OT — the reason is still required

err.load: OT could not be loaded — try again.
err.reason: Write the reason for this correction first.
err.numbers: Corrected hours and rate must be numbers, zero or more.
err.save: The OT correction could not be saved — try again.
err.history: The history could not be loaded — try again.
err.employees: Employees could not be loaded — try again.
err.limits: The OT limits must be numbers, zero or more.
err.limits_save: The OT limits could not be saved — try again.
err.grade_reason: Type a reason first — every grade OT change is audited.
err.grade: The grade's OT could not be saved — try again.
err.worker_ot: Worker OT could not be saved — try again.
err.line: The line's employees could not be loaded.
err.decision: The decision could not be recorded — check the connection and try again.

limits.title: OT Limits
limits.sub: Main payroll only — Complex Management is not affected
limits.note: The limits apply to every OT day main payroll pays — Daily Salary, Monthly Salary, OT Salary, OT Correction and the OT reports — for days not yet inside a finalized payroll. A saved OT Correction is paid as typed.

hint.start_after_min: OT Start Time = shift end + this. The buffer is not paid. 0 = OT from the shift end.
hint.grace_min: A stay this close to the next rounding step is rounded up to it. 0 = no grace.
hint.general_rounding_min: Graded workers' OT is rounded down to this step — whole hours only (60 or more). 60 = as attendance writes it.
hint.worker_rounding_min: Staff Worker OT is rounded down to this step — whole hours only (60 or more).
hint.break_min: Taken out of a day's OT once it runs past the hours below. 0 = no OT break.
hint.break_after_hours: The OT break applies to OT longer than this.
hint.min_minutes: A day's OT shorter than this pays nothing. 0 = no minimum.
hint.max_hours_day: A day's OT above this is capped. 0 = no cap.

grades.title: Grade-wise General OT
grades.sub: Which grades earn General OT after the shift end — main payroll only
grades.reason_hint: Required before switching a grade — written to the audit trail.
grades.note: A grade switched off earns no General OT from the next payroll not yet finalized; days already inside a finalized payroll are not changed. Staff never earn General OT whatever the grade.

rd.employee-master: Every recorded field of each employee: identity, placement, salary structure and contact.

rd.daily-attendance: Every employee's IN, OUT, hours, late and early-out minutes and status for one day.
rd.monthly-attendance: Per-employee totals for a month: present, absent, leave, late, missing punch and hours.
rd.absent: Active employees absent on a day, including those with no punch at all.
rd.late: Late arrivals after the shift's grace time, with late minutes.
rd.early-out: Employees who left before the shift ended, with early-out minutes.
rd.missing-punch: Days with an IN and no OUT, or an OUT and no IN.

rd.monthly-salary: Each employee's monthly salary slip for a pay period.

rd.payslip: One employee's payslip for a pay period, component by component.
rd.salary-deduction: Late deduction, head-wise deductions and loan / advance recovery per slip.
rd.allowance: Allowances paid or entered for a pay period, by employee and allowance.

rd.bank-salary-sheet: Net pay with each employee's salary bank account, for the bank advice.
